lessons: Ticket contradicts itself: a keep removes the stem from reject_queue (runner.py verdict), so the inbox scope and criterion 5 make a second keep stale, but criterion 4 requires the 'already kept at this ticket content' refusal. Rewrite the eligibility rule or criterion 4.

Suggested fix: the inbox accepts every null-hold_id confirm/reject request, and the shared lock-free verdict function decides refusal. Narrow criterion 5 to the cases that function refuses, so there is still one copy of the rules.

The goal says every lock-free confirm/reject must work under serve, but the lock-free reject path accepts non-settled stems that are neither drafts nor in reject_queue. Widen the inbox eligibility to match that path, or narrow the goal.

Before re-confirming, read the keep/reject branches of runner.py verdict (the already-kept check, the reject_queue check, the settled check). Make the inbox and stale criteria match them exactly, then run chupa review on the stem.
